newsitem.title: COMOROS: Survivors of Ethiopia air crash not badly hurt.
newsitem.headline: Survivors of Ethiopia air crash not badly hurt.

text.p: Less than 10 of the 50 or so survivors of Saturday's Ethiopan Airlines plane crash off the Comoros Islands are seriously injured, the director general of the island's main radio station said.
"There are about 50 injured according to the latest news. The majority don't have serious injuries, less than 10 are seriously injured," Mohamed Cheikh of Radio des Iles told Reuters.
Cheikh said the "whole island had been mobilised" by the government to take part in the rescue operation.
"There's a good chance that by tonight we will have got all the bodies from the plane," he said.
He said that a team of doctors had flown in from the nearby French-run island of La Reunion to help treat the injured.
Sources in the Ethiopian Airlines head office in Addis Ababa said the company's investigation team had now arrived in the Comoros, but did not expect to have any information until Sunday.
